messages:
Ava (PM): Quick sync  we need to freeze the MVP surface by EOD Friday so legal/ops can sign off. Acmes non-negotiable: 95ms median embeddings on Dedicated.
Sam (Eng): Thats a hard SL. We can meet it by pinning quantized-v2, but theres measurable drop on some semantic prompts.
Riley (SRE): 95ms median is achievable if we pre-provision capacity (reserve 2x autoscale) during peak windows. Cost goes up.
Jordan (Design): Acme said they're ok with occasional degraded UX for edge cases; they want a deterministic fallback policy documented.
Priya (Solutions): Note: their GA milestone is in-contract. We must present a gating plan: feature-flagged default + documented soft-fallback.
Ava (PM): My proposal: ship Phase A (MVP) with quantized-v2 pinned for Acme on Dedicated. Phase B (v1) expands model family after regression checks.
Sam (Eng): Two questions: who defines the regression thresholds? and what exact metrics move us from A -> B?
Jordan (Design): Include a UX-focused eval set (signup, search, snippet generation). If hallucination increases by >2% relative, block promotion.
Riley (SRE): Ops thresholds: error rate under 0.5% and p99 < 450ms for the dedicated pool observed over 24h; autoscale headroom >= 15%.
Priya (Solutions): Customer-side requirement: 95ms median for embeddings for tenants with <50k qpm monthly. They also want the fallback behaviour in the SLO appendix.
Ava (PM): Draft gating checklist (sketch):
```
MVP (Phase A) gating checklist:
- Model pinned: quantized-v2
- Observed median embeddings <=95ms (1h rolling window)
- Eval pass: core-ux-prompt-suite >=98%
- Ops: reserved autoscale slots + runbook linked
- Contract: fallback and notification cadence documented
```
Sam (Eng): Suggest autoslice routing: route Acme to Dedicated until p95 < 200ms sustained for 12h. Limits blast radius on model flips.
Riley (SRE): We can implement routing: if p95 >= 200ms -> route to Hosted with throttled concurrency + alert on-call.
Ava (PM): Fallback should degrade gracefully (shorter context window, deterministic sampling) rather than drop features. Jordan, you'll own the microcopy.
Jordan (Design): Will do. I'll prepare fallback messaging and the tooltip copy to explain degraded mode.
Priya (Solutions): I'll draft the SLO appendix wording and the contract addendum. Customer notification: 48h notice before any routing rule that materially affects SLAs.
Sam (Eng): Engineering deliverables:
- autoslice routing rule (PR by Wed)
- feature-flag + model-pin for quantized-v2 (PR by Thu)
- per-tenant median embeddings dashboard (by Thu)
Ava (PM): Owners: Sam (infra + flags), Riley (runbook + monitoring), Jordan (UX copy), Priya (customer docs). I'll circulate the checklist and schedule a Thursday sync.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary: canary/dedicated-acme/2023-09-14-03 started by Sam.
Sam (Eng): One more constraint: if quantized-v2 shows >3% regression on semantic evals within 48h post-rollout, auto-switch back to Hosted and file rollback ticket.
Ava (PM): Add that as a hard stop in the checklist. No exceptions.
Riley (SRE): I'll attach the rollback playbook and the runbook snippet to the checklist doc.
Priya (Solutions): After checklist finalization I'll send the updated SLO appendix & the addendum to Acme.
Ava (PM): Thanks team  if no blockers we target scope freeze Friday 18:00 PT. Please update the PRs and dashboard links before the Thursday follow-up. :thumbsup:
